GLOBAL STYLE
Stylized 3D CG in the language of a modern animated feature film, matching the supplied image exactly in material, colour, layout and proportion. Deliberately not photorealistic. 16:9.

SCENE
A slow camera move through the empty jungle hut, filmed as a location reference so the geometry of the whole room is readable.

LOCATION
The interior of the jungle hut in the supplied image: bamboo and plank walls, a teal woven couch with dented cushions, an old boxy television on a wooden crate with SNERTFLIX in red on the screen and a stalled loading circle, a paper lantern hanging above the couch, an amber blanket on the floor, a bowl of snacks, a remote on the couch arm, flip-flops by the doorway, a shallow puddle inside the door, big jungle leaves and heavy rain beyond the window and the open doorway.

FIRST FRAME AND BLOCKING
The shot opens on exactly the framing of the supplied image: the television slightly left of centre, the couch on the right, the lantern top right.

Shot 1, one continuous shot with no cuts: the camera drifts slowly and steadily to the left and a little forward, revealing the wall behind the television, the corner beside it and the floor in front of the couch, then continues past the couch to show the doorway and the wall on the right. The move is smooth and even from the first frame to the last, like a dolly on rails.

OPTICS / CAMERA
One fixed normal lens of 47 degrees diagonal field of view at couch height. No zoom, no focus pull, no handheld drift. The camera only translates.

PHYSICS
Rain falls steadily outside and runs off the leaves. The lantern hangs still. Nothing inside the room moves.

LIGHTING
Flat silver-grey daylight through the window and the doorway as the main light, the paper lantern as a warm second light above the couch. Even exposure throughout, every surface legible.

POSITIVE LOCKS
The room is empty for the whole shot: every shape in the frame is furniture, wall, floor, plant or prop. Nobody enters. The layout, the props and their positions stay exactly as in the supplied image. SNERTFLIX stays red on the television screen.

AUDIO
No music, no dialogue. Only the sound of rain outside and a faint creak of the roof.
